findings.text: - **Fact about a projection:** "The agency projects a population of 10 million by 2030." This can be verified by checking the agency's published projection.

findings.text: - **Projection itself:** "The population will be 10 million in 2030." This concerns an uncertain future outcome and depends on assumptions.
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: - **Opinion:** "A population of 10 million would be disastrous." This is an evaluative judgment unless the relevant standard of "disastrous" is defined and defended.
